request.deadline: Instantly performed as part of governance action enactment on-chain
deliverables: Instant on-chain treasury withdrawal to reimburse the lost 100,000 ADA deposit
Additional 3,000 ADA compensation for lost staking rewards
request.recipient: Ikigai Info governance action submitter; exact address or identity not stated in document
request.what: Reimburse the submitter of the Ikigai Info governance action for an unrecovered governance action deposit plus estimated lost staking rewards.

claims.claim: The proposal requests 103,000 ADA from the treasury to reimburse a lost 100,000 ADA governance action deposit and 3,000 ADA of estimated lost staking rewards.
The original Ikigai Info governance action deposit could not be recovered because a Cardano node bug permitted an unregistered stake key to be used in the governance action.
The Ikigai Info governance action was a symbolic action asking the community whether they agreed with a statement thanking contributors and expressing hope for Cardano's future.
The proposer states there was significant community sentiment at the time that the Ikigai Info governance action deposit should be reimbursed.
The Cardano in Oceania initiative included the deposit reimbursement in its budget Info governance action, but that governance action was not approved.
The proposal says there are no costs or expenses associated with the treasury withdrawal beyond the reimbursement amount.
The proposal states the recipient has not previously received treasury funds.
The proposal states the requested amount does not exceed the current Net Change Limit.
The proposal says the community can audit the distribution on-chain because funds will be made directly available to the intended recipient.
The document provides an external reference URL to an AdaStat governance action page for the Ikigai action.

summary: The document asks for a 103,000 ADA treasury withdrawal to reimburse a past Ikigai Info governance action deposit that the proposer says was unrecoverable due to a node bug, with most key facts asserted and only limited external reference material provided.
